सुपरस्टार प्रभास अपनी मच-अवेटेड फिल्म पर लौटने के लिए बिल्कुल तैयार हैं। 🔥
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, प्रभास डायरेक्टर संदीप रेड्डी वांगा की फिल्म Spirit की शूटिंग 15 दिसंबर से दोबारा शुरू करेंगे। 📅
फैंस इस धमाकेदार फिल्म का बेसब्री से इंतजार कर रहे हैं। 🤩
क्या आप भी प्रभास और संदीप रेड्डी वांगा की इस नई जोड़ी को बड़े पर्दे पर देखने के लिए सुपर एक्साइटेड हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में जल्दी से बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Spirit: Prabhas to get back to filming Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s film on December 15; Here's what we know
ctx.summary:
Prabhas has an exciting lineup of projects, including filmmaker  Sandeep Reddy Vanga  directorial Spirit. Amid his ongoing commitments to Fauzi, the actor is reportedly gearing up to return to the sets of the much-awaited cop-action drama next month. According to a report by 123Telugu, Prabhas is expected to resume shooting for the film on December 15, 2026. 
 Prabhas to shoot for Spirit before returning to Fauzi 
 As per the report, Prabhas will join the sets of  Spirit  for a brief shooting schedule and wrap up a few days of work before shifting his attention back to Fauzi. The actor is currently filming the Hanu Raghavapudi directorial, making it necessary to coordinate the schedules of both ambitious projects. 
 Spirit release date pushed to Diwali 2027 
 Meanwhile, Spirit has also undergone a change in its theatrical release plans. The film was initially scheduled to arrive in cinemas in March 2027. However, Sandeep Reddy Vanga announced a revised release window in October, confirming that the movie would now arrive during Diwali 2027. 
 The film will feature Prabhas as an officer who reportedly has 'one bad habit'. Triptii Dimri has been cast as the female lead, while Vivek Oberoi and Aishwarya Desai will be seen in important roles. The first look, unveiled towards the end of 2025, showcased Prabhas in a rugged and bruised avatar alongside Triptii. 
 About Prabhas' Fauzi 
 Apart from Spirit, Prabhas is busy with Fauzi, a period action thriller directed by Hanu Raghavapu
